about: Cochin Minerals and Rutile Ltd is a 100% export-oriented mineral- processing company that manufactures synthetic rutile and iron /titanium co-products at Edayar, Kochi. Synthetic rutile is high-grade titanium feedstock used in titanium dioxide pigment and titanium sponge/metal. [1]
